name: robos-llm
description: RobOS optional API mode — direct model calls (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama) through LangChain.js. Off by default; the coding-agent CLIs stay the default path.

robos.comment: Not installed with RobOS. Preferences installs these into ~/.local/share/robos/llm-deps when the user turns API mode on. @langchain/openai is held at 1.5.8, the last release that supports the Node 20 runtime in Electron 30.
